change_log.value: Audit Logging and Internal API Exposure for Brain Operations
change_log.note: Expanded to include API/UI layer responsibility

change_log.value: Standardize audit logs for GPTReader and manifest operations and expose internal read-only endpoints for audit inspection, including request_id, timestamp, actor, query scope, response size, and outcome. Ensure compatibility with existing debug_logger and Brain observability patterns.

stories.title: GPTReader Response Schema and Manifest Contract
stories.description: Define and enforce a strict response schema for GPTReader including document limits, size caps (500KB), manifest-aligned metadata (source, collection, record_id), and error contract for consistent downstream consumption.

stories.title: Manifest Validation and Drift Detection Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to validate that GPTReader queries and outputs align with the current project manifest, including file existence checks, hash validation, and detection of stale or missing entries.

stories.title: GPTReader Reliability Enhancements (Limits and Fallbacks)
stories.description: Enhance GPTReader to handle edge cases including oversized queries, partial reads, and Mongo timeouts by enforcing limits (100 docs, 500KB) and introducing safe fallback responses with clear error signaling.

stories.title: Audit Logging and Internal API Exposure for Brain Operations
stories.description: Standardize audit logs for GPTReader and manifest operations and expose internal read-only endpoints for audit inspection, including request_id, timestamp, actor, query scope, response size, and outcome. Ensure compatibility with existing debug_logger and Brain observability patterns.

stories.title: GPTReader and Manifest Integration Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema compliance, manifest alignment, drift detection, limit enforcement, and audit logging consistency across GPTReader operations.
